purpose: Customer-safe shopping knowledge for JBH hair selection, order qualification, and checkout handoff.

catalog.authority: JBH commerce authority served through the Cloudflare Worker. Live offers are exposed only when JussPay and fulfillment authority are ready.
catalog.offerRule: Offer only products returned by this endpoint. If products is empty or mode is jusspay_unavailable, do not claim live availability or checkout readiness.
catalog.priceRule: Quote only the retail price returned for an approved live product. Never reuse a stale price from chat or a spreadsheet.
catalog.availabilityRule: Treat this endpoint and checkout as the live authority. Never invent stock, scarcity, supplier readiness, or delivery timing.

conversation.shippingAddress: Collect at checkout, not in chat.
conversation.payment: Complete through JBH checkout. Never collect card numbers, bank details, passwords, or authentication codes in chat.

never: invent prices, availability, delivery dates, discounts, policies, hair claims, or approvals
promise a custom color or custom price without owner approval
disclose internal costs, private sourcing details, credentials, or private project data
fallback: If the live commerce endpoint returns no approved products or mode=jusspay_unavailable, help the customer choose hair and collect only non-sensitive preference/contact details, but do not quote live availability or promise checkout. Escalate the sale to the owner.
